Here are some of the key benefits of live chat software.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"resolve-customer-questions-faster\"\u003eResolve customer questions faster\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eLive chat gives customers immediate access to support, eliminating the wait for an email response or phone callback. Real-time conversations help reduce wait times, accelerate issue resolution, and improve the overall customer experience.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"provide-personalized-support-at-scale\"\u003eProvide personalized support at scale\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eLive chat platforms combine customer history, conversation context, and AI-powered assistance to help agents deliver more relevant, personalized responses. A centralized view of every interaction enables consistent support across channels and touchpoints.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"offer-247-customer-service\"\u003eOffer 24/7 customer service\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAI agents and self-service tools can resolve common questions outside business hours and escalate more complex requests to human agents when needed. This helps businesses provide continuous support without requiring around-the-clock staffing.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"improve-agent-efficiency\"\u003eImprove agent efficiency\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAutomation, intelligent routing, canned responses, and unified workspaces reduce manual work and help agents manage multiple conversations simultaneously. These capabilities improve productivity while allowing teams to scale support more efficiently.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"increase-conversions-and-customer-loyalty\"\u003eIncrease conversions and customer loyalty\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eProactive live chat helps businesses engage customers when purchase intent is high, answer questions before they become obstacles, and reduce friction throughout the buying journey. Faster, more personalized support can improve customer satisfaction, encourage repeat business, and increase conversion opportunities.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e \u003cspan id=\"how-to-choose-the-right-live-chat-software\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e","id":"text-09180c096f",":type":"zendesk/components/text/v1/text"}},":itemsOrder":["heading","text"]},"id":"teaser-812da2cb58",":type":"zendesk/components/base/v1/base"},"base_copy_7":{"noOfButtons":0,"hasContentBackground":false,"shouldStretchWeightedColumn":false,"reverseLayout":false,"removePadding":false,"hasRoundedCorners":false,"includeBreadcrumbs":false,"splitBackground":false,"additionalContent":{"id":"container-9535a1367c",":type":"zendesk/components/container/v1/container",":items":{"heading":{"text":"How to choose the right live chat software","id":"title-cadb58124e",":type":"zendesk/components/heading/v1/heading"},"text":{"richText":true,"text":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cp\u003eWhen it comes to providing live chat support, there are plenty of live chat apps to choose from. The live chat software that’s right for you depends on your growth plan, desired features, customer base, and more. For example, if you have a website supported by a WordPress engine, you’ll need to choose live chat software that can support \u003ca href=\"/service/messaging/wordpress-chatbot/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003eWordPress chatbots\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\u003cp\u003eHere are a few common factors to consider when selecting the best live chat services:\u003c/p\u003e\r\n\u003cul\u003e\r\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIntegration support:\u003c/strong\u003e To get the most out of your live chat software, it must integrate with the rest of your business ecosystem. The \u003ca href=\"/marketplace/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003eZendesk Marketplace\u003c/a\u003e boasts more than 1,700 plug-and-play integrations that empower and support service teams.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEase of use:\u003c/strong\u003e Choose a solution like Zendesk that’s intuitively designed with agents in mind. This allows your team to spend more time helping customers and less time understanding complex software.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eScalability:\u003c/strong\u003e The ideal live chat software can scale with your business so you don’t have to worry about upgrading your plan or switching to a new solution as your support team and customer base grows.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTotal cost of ownership (TCO):\u003c/strong\u003e Live chat software like Zendesk considers the \u003ca href=\"/blog/agility-total-cost-customer-experience/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003eTCO of CX\u003c/a\u003e, sets up fast, and works right out of the box with no hidden costs to enable teams to continue providing stellar service without missing a beat.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAI:\u003c/strong\u003e The best live chat software includes AI capabilities to help your business streamline processes and do more with less. With our cutting-edge AI technology, Zendesk can intelligently anticipate \u003ca href=\"/blog/customer-needs/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003ecustomer needs\u003c/a\u003e, promote self-service support, and provide instant answers using natural human language.\u003c/li\u003e\r\n\u003c/ul\u003e\r\n\u003cp\u003eBy keeping these five factors in mind, your business can land on a live chat solution that holistically benefits your organization for years to come.\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cspan id=\"frequently-asked-questions\"\u003e\u003c/span\u003e","id":"text-6635ec62aa",":type":"zendesk/components/text/v1/text"}},":itemsOrder":["heading","text"]},"id":"teaser-df80d3883e",":type":"zendesk/components/base/v1/base"},"base_copy_8":{"noOfButtons":0,"hasContentBackground":false,"shouldStretchWeightedColumn":false,"reverseLayout":false,"removePadding":false,"hasRoundedCorners":false,"includeBreadcrumbs":false,"splitBackground":false,"additionalContent":{"id":"container-d7220c2997",":type":"zendesk/components/container/v1/container",":items":{"heading":{"text":"Frequently asked questions","id":"title-4cd20a75d4",":type":"zendesk/components/heading/v1/heading"},"text":{"richText":true,"text":"\u003cp\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"accordion js-accordion\"\u003e\n \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-item\"\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-closed\"\u003e\n   \u003ch3 id=\"whats-the-difference-between-live-chat-and-help-desk-software\"\u003eWhat’s the difference between live chat and help desk software?\u003c/h3\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-open\"\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eThe difference between live chat and \u003ca href=\"/service/help-desk-software/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003ehelp desk software\u003c/a\u003e is that live chat software focuses on one-on-one chat conversations between customers and support agents. In contrast, help desk software fields support inquiries across multiple channels, like email, SMS, voice, and live chat.\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eWith a complete customer service solution like Zendesk, businesses can reap the benefits of a help desk and live chat software in one solution.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-item\"\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-closed\"\u003e\n   \u003ch3 id=\"whats-the-difference-between-live-chat-and-chatbots\"\u003eWhat’s the difference between live chat and chatbots?\u003c/h3\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-open\"\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eThe main differences between live chat and chatbots include:\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cul\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003eInteraction type: Autonomous support from humans or AI agents versus script or algorithm-based interactions.\u003c/li\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003eUse case: Customer support and complex interactions versus FAQs, lead generation, and basic inquiries.\u003c/li\u003e\n   \u003c/ul\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eMany teams use live chat and chatbots together, relying on chatbots for routine requests and live chat for more complex, real-time support.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-item\"\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-closed\"\u003e\n   \u003ch3 id=\"is-live-chat-software-worth-it-for-a-small-business\"\u003eIs live chat software worth it for a small business?\u003c/h3\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-open\"\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eThe best live chat software for small businesses depends on your company’s specific needs. Zendesk’s live chat software is great for small businesses looking to integrate live chat, ticket automation, and multichannel support with advanced reporting features.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-item\"\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-closed\"\u003e\n   \u003ch3 id=\"can-live-chat-software-support-customers-247\"\u003eCan live chat software support customers 24/7?\u003c/h3\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-open\"\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eYes, modern live chat software provides 24/7 customer support to customers. By combining AI agents, chatbots, and self-service resources with human agents, AI resolves common questions, surface relevant knowledge base articles, and escalate more complex issues to the appropriate team with full conversation context. This allows businesses to offer continuous support while reserving human expertise for requests that require it.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-item\"\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-closed\"\u003e\n   \u003ch3 id=\"what-types-of-companies-need-live-chat-software\"\u003eWhat types of companies need live chat software?\u003c/h3\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-open\"\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eLive chat is useful for any company that provides customer service. It supports everything from answering questions to resolving problems in real-time, making it a core part of modern \u003ca href=\"/blog/customer-service-skills/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003ecustomer service\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eLive chat is often a cost-effective option to offer faster, more convenient customer service. It also supports lead generation and sales conversations. For example, ecommerce teams may use a \u003ca href=\"/service/messaging/shopify-live-chat/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"\u003eShopify live chat app\u003c/a\u003e to assist customers throughout the customer journey.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003c/div\u003e\n \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-item\"\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-closed\"\u003e\n   \u003ch3 id=\"what-are-the-different-types-of-live-chat-software\"\u003eWhat are the different types of live chat software?\u003c/h3\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n  \u003cdiv class=\"accordion-open\"\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eThere are several types of live chat software, including:\u003c/p\u003e\n   \u003cul\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStandalone live chat software:\u003c/strong\u003e Software that focuses solely on live chat, often resulting in siloed or lost customer conversations.\u003c/li\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eOmnichannel live chat software:\u003c/strong\u003e Platforms that integrate multiple communication channels—such as live chat, email, phone, and social media—into a unified interface.\u003c/li\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eChat widget:\u003c/strong\u003e Solutions that let customers message businesses via a chat window on a website or mobile app.\u003c/li\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eMessaging apps:\u003c/strong\u003e Software that allows customers to contact companies through channels like SMS, social media, WhatsApp, Apple Business Chat, and Messenger.\u003c/li\u003e\n    \u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eAI agents:\u003c/strong\u003e AI-powered bots that can autonomously handle basic and complex customer inquiries.\u003c/li\u003e\n   \u003c/ul\u003e\n   \u003cp\u003eWhen choosing between different types of live chat software, consider your business’s specific needs.\u003c/p\u003e\n  \u003c/div\u003e\n
